request: Tasbeeh counter. I pick the target: 33, 99 or 100, and it counts taps and tells me when I reach it. Also reset button.
program:
app "Tasbeeh" beads mint
table tap
setting target num = 33 "Count to"
let n = count(tap today)
draw width 240 tap add tap
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
button "Reset today" tap remove all tap today
describe:
Tasbeeh, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- tap: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Count to": number, starts at 33.
Works out:
- n is how many tap entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a tap.
- a button "Reset today"; a tap removes all tap entries today, with one undo.

program:
app "Egg count" egg mint
table eggs day date = today, n num 0.. "Eggs collected", cracked num 0.. = 0
setting hens num 1.. = 12
setting price money = 40 "Price per egg (Rs)"
let mon = today - weekday(today) + 1
let wk = sum(eggs.n where day >= mon)
row gap 3
  stat wk, "eggs this week"
  stat fixed(wk / (hens * 7), 2), "per hen per day"
stat sum(eggs where day >= mon, (it.n - it.cracked) * price), "income this week (Rs)"

describe:

request: deploy checklist for prod release: run tests, db backup, migrate, deploy, smoke test, notify team. tick each, then a reset button for next release.

checklist.item: list of the named checklist steps with tick boxes
shows how many steps are done of total
shows a clear ready/all done state

program:
app " Deployments" target slate
table deploy name text, due date, done bool
count(deploy where done = no) "tests left" big
each deploy where done = no sort due as r
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    toggle r.done
    stack grow
      r.name bold
      r.due small color if(r.due < today, bad, muted)
form deploy
"Done" faint
list deploy where done = yes
button "Reset next release" tap remove all deploy where done = yes
describe:
Deployments, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- deploy: name: text; due: date; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many deploy entries where done is no, "tests left".
- for each deploy where done is no sorted by due:
  - a group; a tap opens the deploy for editing; a swipe removes the deploy, with undo:
    - a tick box for the done of the deploy.
    - text: the name of the deploy.
    - text: the due of the deploy.
- a form to add a deploy.
- text: "Done".
- a list of deploy where done is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- a button "Reset next release"; a tap removes all deploy entries where done is yes, with one undo.

request: Loan EMI: amount, yearly interest rate, months. Show monthly payment and total interest paid. I'd like it to fetch today's bank rates too.

checklist.item: inputs for amount, annual rate and months

program:
app "EMI" money ocean
state amount money = 50000
state rate num = 12
state months num = 12
field amount "Loan amount"
field rate "Yearly rate %"
field months "Months"
"Monthly payment" round(amount * pow(1 + rate / 1200, months) / 12) big
"Total interest paid" round(amount * (1 + rate / 1200 - 100 * months) / 12) faint
describe:
EMI, in the ocean colours.
Remembers while you use it: amount, starting at 50000; rate, starting at 12; months, starting at 12.
Shows:
- a box to fill in amount, labelled "Loan amount".
- a box to fill in rate, labelled "Yearly rate %".
- a box to fill in months, labelled "Months".
- text: "Monthly payment", amount times the pow of 1 plus rate divided by 1200 divided by 12 rounded.
- text: "Total interest paid", amount times the result of 1 plus rate divided by 1200 minus 100 times months divided by 12 rounded.

request: home tuition students - name, class, fee per month, day they come, fee paid this month?

checklist.item: can add a student with name, class and monthly fee

program:
app "Tuition fees" school ocean
table student name text, class text, fee money "Monthly fee"
table visit student ref student, amount money
table paid student ref student, amount money
"Fees pending this month" sum(visit.amount month) big
each student sort name as s
  row card gap 2
    s.name bold grow
    s.class faint
    sum(s.visit.amount month) "of" s.fee faint
    if sum(s.visit.amount month) > s.fee
      button "Paid" tap add paid student = s, amount = s.fee
form student, "Add student"
form visit, "Add visit"
describe:
Tuition fees, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- student: name: text; class: text; "Monthly fee": money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- visit: student: a student; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- paid: student: a student; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Fees pending this month", the total amount of visit this month.
- for each student sorted by name:
  - text: the name of the student.
  - text: the class of the student.
  - text: the total amount of the student's visit entries this month, "of", the fee of the student.
  - if the total amount of the student's visit entries this month is more than the fee of the student:
    - a button "Paid"; a tap adds a paid with student set to the student, amount set to the fee of the student.
- a form to add a student.
- a form to add a visit.

request: volleyball match scoreboard: sets to 25 points, win by 2, best of 5 sets. show sets won for each side too.

checklist.item: shows current set score for two teams
tap buttons add a point to each team
shows sets won by each team
indicates when a set is won

program:
app "Volleyball" ball ocean
table set side pick Left|Right, pts num 1..500 = 1
let l = sum(set.pts where side = Left)
let r = sum(set.pts where side = Right)
let w = max(l + r, 25)
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Left" bold
    w big
  stack card grow align center
    "Right" bold
    w big
button "Won!" tap add set side = Left then add set side = Right
button "Best set" tap add set side = Left, pts = 25
"Sets won" count(set where side = Left) faint
describe:
Volleyball, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- set: side: one of Left, Right; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- l is the total pts of set where side is Left.
- r is the total pts of set where side is Right.
- w is the larger of l plus r and 25.
Shows:
- text: "Left".
- text: w.
- text: "Right".
- text: w.
- a button "Won!"; a tap adds a set with side set to Left, then adds a set with side set to Right.
- a button "Best set"; a tap adds a set with side set to Left, pts set to 25.
- text: "Sets won", how many set entries where side is Left.
